we have cloned and characterized a new heat shock promoter, designated phtpY, located 0.7 kb upstream of the dnaJ gene and transcribed in the opposite direction of the dnaK and dnaJ genes.
we have discovered a new E. coli heat shock gene and characterized it at the molecular level.
htpY encodes a new member of the heat shock family of proteins, and its overproduction results in the activation of the heat shock regulon.
